proposed_capability: Promote PrintWindow-measured (approximate) Live inventory-panel Multiselect toggle client coords into fixed-ui-click-map v11 as additive seeds, and record the panel's Sell button as a FORBIDDEN_DENY target that can never be attested as a HIT or resolved as clickable. Operator rule: agents never sell or delete household items.
player_save_control_impact: Records fixed panel coordinates and a deny policy only. No save, game file, or live input is touched by this change. Sell button is contractually unclickable (FORBIDDEN_DENY).
expected_outcome: fixed-ui-click-map v11: seeds live.inventory_multiselect_toggle and live.inventory_sell_button (FORBIDDEN_DENY), inventory_multiselect_1920x1080 block, load_inventory_multiselect_coords loader, record_click_attempt refuses HIT on FORBIDDEN targets, resolve_target_xy flags denied targets; unit tests; receipt under horizon-exec-20261110/bi002.
negative_tests: Sell button cannot be recorded as HIT
Sell and Multiselect toggle coords differ by more than near-miss radius
rollback_path: Revert contract v11 additions and the two guard edits in betterinstincts/fixed_ui_click_map.py; v10 content is untouched.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact client_xy of Multiselect toggle and Sell button are approximate single-session measurements
Whether the Household vs personal inventory scope is a tab inside the same panel opened by live.panel_inventory
decision_rationale: Multiselect path blocked the Eat queue in live session; Sell sits next to Multiselect and deletes/sells items. Durable deny-by-contract prevents repeat. Offline map edit only; no game input.
